title: Bayesian Ordered Lattice Design (BOLD) Phase I Trial Simulator
description: Independent BOLD/BOIN research simulator. Defaults corrected September 22, 2026: each designated in-range MTD has true DLT probability 0.30; the four-dose highest-MTD vector is (0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30). Configurable dose counts, starting dose, BOLD priors, PESS, toxicity cutoffs and stopping limits. Includes regenerated six-scenario results and a selected upper-dose figure, with explicit safety trade-offs. Experimental BOLD is a separate analysis, not an app option. Research/design review only, not live clinical dose assignment. Existing published archives predate this correction. Method: https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.70456. App: https://wguo3.shinyapps.io/bold_boin_phase1_app/.
